title: Walk the row
intro: Plug a laptop in at one seat after the other: Floorbit shows which switch port just came up, and one tap puts that seat on it.
pick: Pick a block and its switch
plugIn: Plug a laptop into the socket at {{seat}}.
unknown: No cable for this seat yet.
waiting: Watching {{switch}} for a port coming up…
switchHint: When the row moves on to the next switch, change it here.
bySyslog: Watching the switch's syslog: a port shows up here within seconds.
noSyslog: Syslog is off, so Floorbit sees a port only when LibreNMS polls the switch, which can take minutes. With the syslog receiver on (SYSLOG_ENABLED) it takes seconds.
